240 identical, fully independent three-quantum chains — no fan-in or fan-out anywhere. Each chain processes one detector of one visit. The dataset written by each task is what the next task consumes.

All 720 quanta — one column per chain, grouped band → visit

g r i z y node opacity encodes stage: isr → calibrateImage → transformPreSourceTable (top to bottom)

Each band row holds 8 visits (exposure IDs below each group); each visit contributes 6 chains, one per detector (41, 42, 47, 49, 50, 58). Every column is a complete, independent pipeline execution.

One visit exploded — exposure 1178, z band

The six detector chains of a single visit never exchange data — parallelism inside a visit is as free as parallelism across visits. Fan-in only appears in later pipeline steps (makeWarp / assembleCoadd), which this nightlyStep1 graph does not include.
